shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'README*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'public/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'server/**' -g '.*'"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' /workspace /home/vercel-sandbox 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install react react-dom react-router-dom lucide-react express && npm install -D vite @vitejs/plugin-react @playwright/test'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install -D vite@''^7 @vitejs/plugin-react@''^5 @playwright/test'
/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p public/covers src server data && cat .gitignore && node --version'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'file public/covers/* && npx playwright --version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "npx playwright --version && python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import os
for filename in os.listdir('public/covers'):
 im=Image.open('public/covers/'+filename)
 print(filename,im.size)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('@playwright/test').then(async ({chromium})=>{const b=await chromium.launch({headless:true});const p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1080},deviceScaleFactor:1});p.on('pageerror',e=>console.log('PAGE ERROR',e.message));await p.goto('http://localhost:3000');await p.waitForLoadState('networkidle');await p.screenshot({path:'/tmp/marginalia-desktop.png',fullPage:true});console.log(await p.locator('body').innerText());await b.close()})\""
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -lh public/covers && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm test'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/main.jsx src/styles.css server/app.js server/app.test.js server/index.js server/seed.js server/store.js vite.config.js index.html README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'function BookPage|if \\(loading\\)|<BookPage|@import|BookPage|useParams|react-router-dom' src/main.jsx src/styles.css && sed -n '610,685p' src/main.jsx && sed -n '910,990p' src/main.jsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat /etc/os-release && command -v dnf && id && ldd /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1243/chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell'
/bin/bash -lc 'sudo dnf install -y nss nspr atk at-spi2-atk dbus-libs libX11 libXcomposite libXdamage libXext libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm libxcb libxkbcommon alsa-lib at-spi2-core'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '705,750p' src/main.jsx && sed -n '998,1025p' src/main.jsx && rg -n 'status === \"reading\" \\? \"selected\"|status === \"finished\" \\? \"selected\"' src/main.jsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'sudo dnf install -y fontconfig dejavu-sans-fonts dejavu-serif-fonts'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=prettier -- prettier --write src/main.jsx src/styles.css && npm run build'
